name: 既存の相手とメール招待先の混在入力
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE actual component LH03-0007「既存の相手とメール招待先の混在入力」.
ORIGINAL Image1 is primary for chip anatomy, proportions, baseline alignment, spacing and fine control details. Mock Image2 is secondary for localized Japanese wording and logical390x128 content structure; do not copy its mint fill or rough substitutes. Image3 style only.
Show ONLY the selected-recipient chip and email input region above its bottom separator. Selected original region is normalized x15..375,y128..209; do not include the header, Invite suggestion row, paper plane, checkbox or keyboard outside that component.
Pure white canvas. At upper left, compact white rounded recipient chip, thin forest-green outline as the meaningful selected-recipient cue (adapt ORIGINAL's pale-blue selected chip; do not remove the selected meaning and do not use mint fill). Within chip small white outlined circular avatar with exact forest-green「佐」, then exact name「佐藤 ゆう」in black. Catalog deliberately replaces the source portrait with Japanese initial; retain that accepted adaptation, do not invent a portrait. No X/delete/checkmark since source chip shows none.
Below at left, one-line sample email exactly「連絡先@example.jp」. Under it a thin quiet neutral horizontal divider spanning the logical component width. No surrounding extra outer card. Keep existing white breathing room, close grouping and clean typography.
Verified native roles: name and avatar Meiryo Bold14px/24px; email Meiryo Regular14px/24px; tracking0. Logical chip148x36px, avatar28x28px, component390x128. Uniformly scale all elements, preserve text on one line. Wide landscape3:1 image with ONE full component readable, centered with modest margins.
No primary action or brand-gradient button belongs in this input subcomponent. Ordinary text #1D1D1D, supporting elements #526173; no colored background, ambient tint, captions, extra fields or invented metrics. Render Japanese and @example.jp accurately.
reviewNotes: 原画像をチップ形状・配置の主参照にし、モックは日本語内容のみ副参照。元の青い選択チップの意味を白面の森林緑の輪郭へ適応、禁止のミント塗りを除去。生成画像を目視し、佐・佐藤 ゆう・連絡先@example.jpの全文と1行、区切り線、追加操作なしを確認。見本メールであり実招待、編集可能性・書体計測・所有者承認は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
